passages.text: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD: “Take a scroll and write on it all the words I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah, and all the nations, from the day I first spoke to you during the reign of Josiah until today.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
This happened in the fourth year of Jehoiakim.
Jehoiakim was the son of Josiah.
Jehoiakim was king of Judah.
The LORD gave Jeremiah a command.
The LORD said, “Take a scroll.
Write on the scroll all the words I have spoken to you.
I have spoken these words about Israel.
I have spoken these words about Judah.
I have spoken these words about all the nations.
I began to speak to you in the days of Josiah.
Josiah was king before Jehoiakim.
Write everything I have spoken to you from that time until today.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הָרְבִיעִ֔ת לִיהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הָיָ֞ה הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵאֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ קַח־ לְךָ֮ מְגִלַּת־ סֵפֶר֒ וְכָתַבְתָּ֣ אֵלֶ֗יהָ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֧רְתִּי אֵלֶ֛יךָ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל וְעַל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְעַל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם מִיּ֞וֹם דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ מִימֵ֣י יֹאשִׁיָּ֔הוּ וְעַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about all the calamity I plan to bring upon them, each of them will turn from his wicked way. Then I will forgive their iniquity and their sin.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jeremiah.
God is the LORD.
God is the God of Israel.
God plans to bring calamity on the people of Judah.
Perhaps the people of Judah will hear about all the calamity God plans to bring.
Each person in Judah has a wicked way.
Perhaps each person will turn from his wicked way.
If they turn, God will forgive their iniquity.
God will also forgive their sin.
passages.original: אוּלַ֤י יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י חֹשֵׁ֖ב לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָהֶ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן יָשׁ֗וּבוּ אִ֚ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ הָרָעָ֔ה וְסָלַחְתִּ֥י לַעֲוֺנָ֖ם וּלְחַטָּאתָֽם׃ס

passages.text: So Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and at the dictation of Jeremiah, Baruch wrote on a scroll all the words that the LORD had spoken to Jeremiah.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
Baruch was the son of Neriah.
Jeremiah called Baruch.
Jeremiah spoke the words of the LORD to Baruch.
Baruch listened to Jeremiah.
Baruch wrote all the words of the LORD on a scroll.
Baruch wrote everything that the LORD had spoken to Jeremiah.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶת־ בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵֽרִיָּ֑ה וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב בָּר֜וּךְ מִפִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלָ֖יו עַל־ מְגִלַּת־ סֵֽפֶר׃

passages.text: Then Jeremiah commanded Baruch, “I am restricted; I cannot enter the house of the LORD; so you are to go to the house of the LORD on a day of fasting, and in the hearing of the people you are to read the words of the LORD from the scroll you have written at my dictation. Read them in the hearing of all the people of Judah who are coming from their cities.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
Baruch was the son of Neriah.
Jeremiah gave Baruch a command.
Jeremiah said, “I am restricted.
I cannot enter the house of the LORD.
You must go to the house of the LORD.
Go on a day of fasting.
Take the scroll you wrote from my dictation.
Read the words of the LORD from the scroll.
Read them so the people in the house of the LORD can hear.
Also read them so all the people of Judah who come from their cities can hear.”
passages.original: וַיְצַוֶּ֣ה יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶת־ בָּר֖וּךְ לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֣י עָצ֔וּר לֹ֣א אוּכַ֔ל לָב֖וֹא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ וּבָאתָ֣ אַתָּ֡ה וְקָרָ֣אתָ בַמְּגִלָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־ כָּתַֽבְתָּ־ מִפִּי֩ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה בְּאָזְנֵ֥י הָעָ֛ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה בְּי֣וֹם צ֑וֹם וְגַ֨ם בְּאָזְנֵ֧י כָל־ יְהוּדָ֛ה הַבָּאִ֥ים מֵעָרֵיהֶ֖ם תִּקְרָאֵֽם׃

passages.text: Perhaps they will bring their petition before the LORD, and each one will turn from his wicked way; for great are the anger and fury that the LORD has pronounced against this people.”
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
The LORD spoke words of warning to Jeremiah.
Jeremiah told Baruch, his scribe, to read these words to the people.
Jeremiah hoped the people would pray to the LORD.
He hoped each person would turn from his evil way.
The LORD had declared great anger and fury against this people.
The LORD’s anger was because of their wickedness.
passages.original: אוּלַ֞י תִּפֹּ֤ל תְּחִנָּתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְיָשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ הָרָעָ֑ה כִּֽי־ גָד֤וֹל הָאַף֙ וְהַ֣חֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: So Baruch son of Neriah did everything that Jeremiah the prophet had commanded him. In the house of the LORD he read the words of the LORD from the scroll.
passages.sermon:
Baruch was the son of Neriah.
Jeremiah was a prophet.
Jeremiah commanded Baruch to do certain things.
Baruch did everything that Jeremiah commanded him.
Baruch read the words of the LORD from the scroll.
Baruch read these words in the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיַּ֗עַשׂ בָּרוּךְ֙ בֶּן־ נֵ֣רִיָּ֔ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖הוּ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֑יא לִקְרֹ֥א בַסֵּ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Now in the ninth month of the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, a fast before the LORD was proclaimed to all the people of Jerusalem and all who had come there from the cities of Judah.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiakim was the son of Josiah.
Jehoiakim was king of Judah.
It was the fifth year of Jehoiakim’s reign.
It was the ninth month.
The leaders proclaimed a fast before the LORD.
All the people in Jerusalem heard this proclamation.
People from the cities of Judah had come to Jerusalem.
All these people were included in the fast.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י בַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַ֠חֲמִשִׁית לִיהוֹיָקִ֨ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁעִ֔י קָרְא֨וּ צ֜וֹם לִפְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְכָל־ הָעָ֗ם הַבָּאִ֛ים מֵעָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: From the chamber of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe, which was in the upper courtyard at the opening of the New Gate of the house of the LORD, Baruch read from the scroll the words of Jeremiah in the hearing of all the people.
passages.sermon:
Baruch was the son of Neriah.
Baruch had a scroll with the words of Jeremiah.
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
Baruch went to the house of the LORD.
Gemariah was the son of Shaphan.
Gemariah was a scribe.
Baruch entered the chamber of Gemariah.
This chamber was in the upper courtyard.
The chamber was at the opening of the New Gate of the house of the LORD.
Baruch stood there.
Baruch read the words of Jeremiah from the scroll.
All the people could hear Baruch reading.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א בָר֥וּךְ בַּסֵּ֛פֶר אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּלִשְׁכַּ֡ת גְּמַרְיָהוּ֩ בֶן־ שָׁפָ֨ן הַסֹּפֵ֜ר בֶּחָצֵ֣ר הָעֶלְי֗וֹן פֶּ֣תַח שַׁ֤עַר בֵּית־ יְהוָה֙ הֶֽחָדָ֔שׁ בְּאָזְנֵ֖י כָּל־ הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: When Micaiah son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the LORD from the scroll, he went down to the scribe’s chamber in the king’s palace, where all the officials were sitting: Elishama the scribe, Delaiah son of Shemaiah, Elnathan son of Achbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the other officials.
passages.sermon:
Micaiah was the son of Gemariah.
Gemariah was the son of Shaphan.
Micaiah heard all the words of the LORD.
He heard these words from the scroll.
He went down to the king’s palace.
He entered the scribe’s chamber.
All the officials were sitting there.
Elishama the scribe was there.
Delaiah son of Shemaiah was there.
Elnathan son of Achbor was there.
Gemariah son of Shaphan was there.
Zedekiah son of Hananiah was there.
All the other officials were there.
passages.original: וַ֠יִּשְׁמַ֗ע מִכָ֨יְהוּ בֶן־ גְּמַרְיָ֧הוּ בֶן־ שָׁפָ֛ן אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל הַסֵּֽפֶר׃ וַיֵּ֤רֶד בֵּית־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ לִשְׁכַּ֣ת הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְהִ֨נֵּה־ שָׁ֔ם כָּל־ הַשָּׂרִ֖ים יֽוֹשְׁבִ֑ים אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע הַסֹּפֵ֡ר וּדְלָיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ שְׁ֠מַעְיָהוּ וְאֶלְנָתָ֨ן בֶּן־ עַכְבּ֜וֹר וּגְמַרְיָ֧הוּ בֶן־ שָׁפָ֛ן וְצִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־ חֲנַנְיָ֖הוּ וְכָל־ הַשָּׂרִֽים׃

passages.text: And Micaiah reported to them all the words he had heard Baruch read from the scroll in the hearing of the people.
passages.sermon:
Micaiah was the son of Gemariah, who was the son of Shaphan.
Micaiah heard Baruch read from the scroll.
Baruch read the words of Jeremiah.
Baruch read these words in the hearing of all the people.
Micaiah went to the officials.
Micaiah told the officials everything he had heard.
Micaiah reported all the words Baruch had read from the scroll.
passages.original: וַיַּגֵּ֤ד לָהֶם֙ מִכָ֔יְהוּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמֵ֑עַ בִּקְרֹ֥א בָר֛וּךְ בַּסֵּ֖פֶר בְּאָזְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: Then all the officials sent word to Baruch through Jehudi son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, saying, “Bring the scroll that you read in the hearing of the people, and come here.” So Baruch son of Neriah took the scroll and went to them.
passages.sermon:
All the officials sat together in the king’s palace.
They wanted to speak with Baruch.
They sent Jehudi to Baruch.
Jehudi was the son of Nethaniah.
Nethaniah was the son of Shelemiah.
Shelemiah was the son of Cushi.
The officials gave Jehudi a message for Baruch.
They said, “Bring the scroll you read to the people.”
They said, “Take it in your hand and come to us.”
Baruch was the son of Neriah.
Baruch took the scroll in his hand.
Baruch went to the officials.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלְח֨וּ כָל־ הַשָּׂרִ֜ים אֶל־ בָּר֗וּךְ אֶת־ יְהוּדִ֡י בֶּן־ נְ֠תַנְיָהוּ בֶּן־ שֶׁלֶמְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ כּוּשִׁי֮ לֵאמֹר֒ הַמְּגִלָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָרָ֤אתָ בָּהּ֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם קָחֶ֥נָּה בְיָדְךָ֖ וָלֵ֑ךְ וַ֠יִּקַּח בָּר֨וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵרִיָּ֤הוּ אֶת־ הַמְּגִלָּה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֖א אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: “Please sit down,” they said, “and read it in our hearing.” So Baruch read it in their hearing.
passages.sermon:
The officials spoke to Baruch.
They said, “Please sit down.”
They said, “Read the scroll to us.”
Baruch sat down.
Baruch read the scroll aloud.
The officials listened to Baruch read.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו שֵׁ֣ב נָ֔א וּקְרָאֶ֖נָּה בְּאָזְנֵ֑ינוּ וַיִּקְרָ֥א בָר֖וּךְ בְּאָזְנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: When they had heard all these words, they turned to one another in fear and said to Baruch, “Surely we must report all these words to the king.”
passages.sermon:
The officials listened to all the words.
They became afraid.
Each man looked at his neighbor in fear.
They spoke to Baruch.
They said, “We must tell the king all these words.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּשָׁמְעָם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים פָּחֲד֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ בָּר֔וּךְ הַגֵּ֤יד נַגִּיד֙ לַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: “Tell us now,” they asked Baruch, “how did you write all these words? Was it at Jeremiah’s dictation?”
passages.sermon:
The officials spoke to Baruch.
They asked Baruch a question.
They said, “Tell us now how you wrote all these words.”
They asked, “Did you write these words from Jeremiah’s dictation?”
passages.original: וְאֶ֨ת־ בָּר֔וּךְ שָׁאֲל֖וּ לֵאמֹ֑ר הַגֶּד־ נָ֣א לָ֔נוּ אֵ֗יךְ כָּתַ֛בְתָּ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִפִּֽיו׃

passages.text: “It was at his dictation,” Baruch replied. “He recited all these words to me and I wrote them in ink on the scroll.”
passages.sermon:
Baruch spoke to them.
Baruch was Jeremiah’s scribe.
Baruch said, “Jeremiah spoke all these words to me.”
Baruch listened to Jeremiah’s words.
Baruch wrote every word on the scroll.
Baruch used ink to write on the scroll.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ בָּר֔וּךְ מִפִּיו֙ יִקְרָ֣א אֵלַ֔י אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַאֲנִ֛י כֹּתֵ֥ב עַל־ הַסֵּ֖פֶר בַּדְּיֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: Then the officials said to Baruch, “You and Jeremiah must hide yourselves and tell no one where you are.”
passages.sermon:
The officials spoke to Baruch.
Baruch was Jeremiah’s scribe.
Jeremiah was a prophet.
The officials told Baruch to hide.
They told Baruch that Jeremiah must hide too.
They commanded Baruch and Jeremiah to keep their location secret.
No one should know where Baruch and Jeremiah are.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ הַשָּׂרִים֙ אֶל־ בָּר֔וּךְ לֵ֥ךְ הִסָּתֵ֖ר אַתָּ֣ה וְיִרְמְיָ֑הוּ וְאִ֥ישׁ אַל־ יֵדַ֖ע אֵיפֹ֥ה אַתֶּֽם׃

passages.text: So the officials went to the king in the courtyard. And having stored the scroll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, they reported everything to the king.
passages.sermon:
The officials went to the king.
They entered the courtyard.
They placed the scroll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe.
Elishama was the scribe.
The officials told the king everything.
They reported all the words to him.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ חָצֵ֔רָה וְאֶת־ הַמְּגִלָּ֣ה הִפְקִ֔דוּ בְּלִשְׁכַּ֖ת אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע הַסֹּפֵ֑ר וַיַּגִּ֙ידוּ֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִֽים׃

passages.text: Then the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it from the chamber of Elishama the scribe. And Jehudi read it in the hearing of the king and all the officials who were standing beside him.
passages.sermon:
The king gave an order to Jehudi.
The king told Jehudi to get the scroll.
Jehudi went to the chamber of Elishama the scribe.
Jehudi took the scroll from that chamber.
Jehudi brought the scroll to the king.
Jehudi read the scroll aloud.
The king listened to the words of the scroll.
All the officials stood beside the king.
The officials also heard the words of the scroll.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־ יְהוּדִ֗י לָקַ֙חַת֙ אֶת־ הַמְּגִלָּ֔ה וַיִּ֨קָּחֶ֔הָ מִלִּשְׁכַּ֖ת אֱלִישָׁמָ֣ע הַסֹּפֵ֑ר וַיִּקְרָאֶ֤הָ יְהוּדִי֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּבְאָזְנֵי֙ כָּל־ הַשָּׂרִ֔ים הָעֹמְדִ֖ים מֵעַ֥ל הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: Since it was the ninth month, the king was sitting in his winter quarters with a fire burning before him.
passages.sermon: The king was sitting in his winter house.\r\nIt was the ninth month.\r\nA fire was burning in front of him.
passages.original: וְהַמֶּ֗לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב֙ בֵּ֣ית הַחֹ֔רֶף בַּחֹ֖דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִ֑י וְאֶת־ הָאָ֖ח לְפָנָ֥יו מְבֹעָֽרֶת׃

passages.text: And as soon as Jehudi had read three or four columns, Jehoiakim would cut them off with a scribe’s knife and throw them into the firepot, until the entire scroll had been consumed by the fire.
passages.sermon:
King Jehoiakim sat in his winter house.
A fire burned in a pot before him.
Jehudi read from the scroll.
He read three or four columns at a time.
After Jehudi read each section, King Jehoiakim acted.
King Jehoiakim took a scribe’s knife.
He cut off the part that was just read.
He threw the cut piece into the firepot.
He kept doing this with each section.
He continued until the entire scroll was burned up in the fire.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כִּקְר֣וֹא יְהוּדִ֗י שָׁלֹ֣שׁ דְּלָתוֹת֮ וְאַרְבָּעָה֒ יִֽקְרָעֶ֙הָ֙ בְּתַ֣עַר הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְהַשְׁלֵ֕ךְ אֶל־ הָאֵ֖שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶל־ הָאָ֑ח עַד־ תֹּם֙ כָּל־ הַמְּגִלָּ֔ה עַל־ הָאֵ֖שׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ הָאָֽח׃

passages.text: Yet in hearing all these words, the king and his servants did not become frightened or tear their garments.
passages.sermon:
The king sat in his winter quarters.
His servants were with him.
They heard all these words.
They did not become afraid.
They did not tear their garments.
passages.original: וְלֹ֣א פָחֲד֔וּ וְלֹ֥א קָרְע֖וּ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵיהֶ֑ם הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְכָל־ עֲבָדָ֔יו הַשֹּׁ֣מְעִ֔ים אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Even though Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, he would not listen to them.
passages.sermon:
Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah were officials in the court of King Jehoiakim of Judah.
They spoke to the king.
They urged the king not to burn the scroll.
The king did not listen to them.
He burned the scroll anyway.
passages.original: וְגַם֩ אֶלְנָתָ֨ן וּדְלָיָ֤הוּ וּגְמַרְיָ֙הוּ֙ הִפְגִּ֣עוּ בַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְבִלְתִּ֥י שְׂרֹ֖ף אֶת־ הַמְּגִלָּ֑ה וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Instead, the king commanded Jerahmeel, a son of the king, as well as Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel, to seize Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet. But the LORD had hidden them.
passages.sermon:
The king gave an order.
He spoke to Jerahmeel, who was the king’s son.
He spoke to Seraiah, who was the son of Azriel.
He spoke to Shelemiah, who was the son of Abdeel.
The king told them to seize Baruch.
Baruch was the scribe.
The king also told them to seize Jeremiah.
Jeremiah was the prophet.
But the LORD hid Baruch and Jeremiah.
No one could find them.
passages.original: וַיְצַוֶּ֣ה הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ אֶת־ יְרַחְמְאֵ֨ל בֶּן־ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וְאֶת־ שְׂרָיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ עַזְרִיאֵ֗ל וְאֶת־ שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּֽן־ עַבְדְּאֵ֔ל לָקַ֙חַת֙ אֶת־ בָּר֣וּךְ הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְאֵ֖ת יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֑יא וַיַּסְתִּרֵ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: After the king had burned the scroll containing the words that Baruch had written at Jeremiah’s dictation, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah: “Take another scroll and rewrite on it the very words that were on the original scroll, which Jehoiakim king of Judah has burned.
passages.sermon:
The king of Judah was Jehoiakim.
Jehoiakim burned the scroll.
Baruch had written the scroll.
Baruch wrote the scroll from the words of Jeremiah.
After this, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah.
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD said, "Take another scroll."
The LORD said, "Write on it all the words that were on the first scroll."
The first scroll was the one Jehoiakim king of Judah burned.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ אַחֲרֵ֣י׀ שְׂרֹ֣ף הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ אֶת־ הַמְּגִלָּה֙ וְאֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּתַ֥ב בָּר֛וּךְ מִפִּ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃ שׁ֥וּב קַח־ לְךָ֖ מְגִלָּ֣ה אַחֶ֑רֶת וּכְתֹ֣ב עָלֶ֗יהָ אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֗וּ עַל־ הַמְּגִלָּה֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂרַ֖ף יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: You are to proclaim concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah that this is what the LORD says: You have burned the scroll and said, ‘Why have you written on it that the king of Babylon would surely come and destroy this land and deprive it of man and beast?’
passages.sermon:
Jehoiakim was the king of Judah.
The LORD spoke about Jehoiakim.
The LORD said this:
"You burned this scroll.
You said, 'Why did you write on it?'
You asked, 'Why did you say the king of Babylon will come?'
You questioned, 'Why did you write that he will destroy this land?'
You asked, 'Why did you say he will remove man and beast from it?'"
passages.original: וְעַל־ יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֙ תֹּאמַ֔ר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אַ֠תָּה שָׂרַ֜פְתָּ אֶת־ הַמְּגִלָּ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מַדּוּעַ֩ כָּתַ֨בְתָּ עָלֶ֜יהָ לֵאמֹ֗ר בֹּֽא־ יָב֤וֹא מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ וְהִשְׁחִית֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את וְהִשְׁבִּ֥ית מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the LORD says about Jehoiakim king of Judah: He will have no one to sit on David’s throne, and his body will be thrown out and exposed to heat by day and frost by night.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke about Jehoiakim.
Jehoiakim was king of Judah.
The LORD said Jehoiakim will have no one to sit on David’s throne.
No descendant of Jehoiakim will rule as king in David’s line.
Jehoiakim’s body will be thrown out after his death.
His body will lie exposed in the heat during the day.
His body will lie exposed to the frost at night.
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַל־ יְהֽוֹיָקִים֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה לֹא־ יִֽהְיֶה־ לּ֥וֹ יוֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל־ כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֑ד וְנִבְלָתוֹ֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה מֻשְׁלֶ֔כֶת לַחֹ֥רֶב בַּיּ֖וֹם וְלַקֶּ֥רַח בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃

passages.text: I will punish him and his descendants and servants for their iniquity. I will bring on them, on the residents of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the calamity about which I warned them but they did not listen.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke about Jehoiakim, king of Judah.
Jehoiakim sinned against God.
God will punish Jehoiakim for his sin.
God will also punish Jehoiakim’s descendants.
God will punish Jehoiakim’s servants.
God will hold them all accountable for their iniquity.
God will bring disaster on Jehoiakim and his family.
God will bring disaster on his servants.
God will bring disaster on the people living in Jerusalem.
God will bring disaster on every man of Judah.
God already warned them about this calamity.
They did not listen to God’s warnings.
God will do everything He said He would do.
passages.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֨י עָלָ֧יו וְעַל־ זַרְע֛וֹ וְעַל־ עֲבָדָ֖יו אֶת־ עֲוֺנָ֑ם וְהֵבֵאתִ֣י עֲ֠לֵיהֶם וְעַל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם וְאֶל־ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֵ֧ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃ס

passages.text: Then Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to the scribe Baruch son of Neriah, and at Jeremiah’s dictation he wrote on it all the words of the scroll that Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire. And many similar words were added to them.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet of the LORD.
Jeremiah took another scroll.
Baruch was the son of Neriah.
Baruch was a scribe.
Jeremiah gave the new scroll to Baruch.
Jeremiah spoke the words.
Baruch wrote the words on the scroll.
Jehoiakim was king of Judah.
Jehoiakim had burned the first scroll in the fire.
Baruch wrote all the words from the first scroll.
Baruch wrote these words as Jeremiah dictated them.
Baruch also added many similar words to the new scroll.
passages.original: וְיִרְמְיָ֜הוּ לָקַ֣ח׀ מְגִלָּ֣ה אַחֶ֗רֶת וַֽיִּתְּנָהּ֮ אֶל־ בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵרִיָּהוּ֮ הַסֹּפֵר֒ וַיִּכְתֹּ֤ב עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ מִפִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂרַ֛ף יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֖ה בָּאֵ֑שׁ וְע֨וֹד נוֹסַ֧ף עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם דְּבָרִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים כָּהֵֽמָּה׃ס
